en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Mhammad, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Al Jaroud, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Among what Musa<sup>as</sup> whispered to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> with, was: ‘O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! What is for the one who washes the dead?’ So He<sup>azwj</sup> Said: “I<sup>azwj</sup> would Wash him from his sins to just as he was when his mother gave birth to him’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Sinan from abu al-Jarud who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

One of the matters that Moses spoke about before Allah was this, “O Allah, what is the reward for one who washes a dead body?” The answer was, “I wash his sins as if his mother has just given him birth.’””
